description: Reference camera of the NM26 broadcast (game 1, video frame at 180 s): OpenCV pinhole, world mm (data/geometry.json, z up) -> video px. Every game's frames register to this frame, and games 3-7 differ only by zoom (camera centre within about 2 cm), so the camera serves all seven games after registration.
method: Decomposed from the ice-plane calibration (g1/calibration.json, the slot ICP) with square pixels and the principal point row fixed at the image centre (the plane alone leaves one degree of freedom; a 54 mm goalie projects to 80-81 px across that whole family). Least-squares refit of f, cx and the pose reproduces the plane homography to 0.00 px. Checked in Blender (identical projection) and against the real goalie slots and cages (docs/synthetic-goalie-pilot.md).
